_comment: OPTIONAL belt-and-suspenders reminder. Merge the 'hooks' block into your Claude Code settings.json (e.g. ~/.claude/settings.json) to be reminded to run skill-review before a skill is copied into a skills directory. This is harness config, NOT part of the skill. Replace <ABS_PATH> with the absolute path to skill_install_guard.py. Verify the PreToolUse payload shape for your Claude Code version. To make it BLOCK instead of remind, set env BLOCK=1 for the command. The update-config skill can apply this for you.
